title: Developer platform Railway urges ‘all users’ to revoke secret keys after cyberattack
slides: Railway users: did attackers already copy your keys?
A cyberattack hit the developer platform's internal systems
Some tokens stayed valid longer than the breach was known
Revoke and rotate every secret key tied to your projects
Check your Railway logs tonight for unfamiliar access
thread_text:
1. Keys copied before fix?

Railway's internal systems were breached. The attacker may have copied your secret keys before anyone noticed.

2. Tokens stayed valid

Some API tokens remained active longer than the breach was known—meaning stolen keys could have been used silently.

3. Check logs tonight

Look for unfamiliar access in your Railway logs. Unusual IPs, unexpected API calls, or new sessions are red flags.

4. Revoke and rotate now

Every secret key tied to your Railway projects must be revoked and rotated. Don't wait for confirmation of misuse.

5. Audit your exposure

Ask yourself: which of your keys were live during the breach window? Rotate those first, then verify no unauthorized actions occurred.
